        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="interested" name="Customer interested?" />
    <bpmn:task id="guide" name="Guide the customer through selecting the product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="quote" name="Provide a quote" />
    <bpmn:task id="approve" name="Approve the quote" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="approved" name="Quote approved?" />
